queries: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS value FROM status_averages), qualifying AS (SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.avg_modelconf FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE s.avg_modelconf > b.value), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS value FROM qualifying) SELECT q.brokrepstat, q.avg_modelconf, q.avg_modelconf - b.value AS above_baseline, q.avg_modelconf / NULLIF(m.value, 0) AS relative_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying AS q CROSS JOIN baseline AS b CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean AS m WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL AND m.value IS NOT NULL;
